minutes.summary: The commission met with some members remote and had technical trouble establishing a quorum. It also covered the Fitchburg sewer ordinance, waiting on ARPA guidance, the business manager's report, and approved the prior minutes.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission recorded no votes on substantive items, and approved the prior meeting's minutes.
Three of four informal proposals for preliminary sewer design on Upland, Eastern, White Street and Maple Parkway were in, with Right Pierce lowest; the fourth was pending.
Contractors grouted an Elizabeth Street main and several services to reduce inflow and infiltration; the invoice had not yet arrived.
The commission heard that federal American Rescue Plan amounts and allocations were still unknown, and the chair suggested a December agenda item on an infrastructure wishlist.
The business manager reported a high monthly Fitchburg sewer invoice, with flow meter work expected to lower later bills; the budget was described as tracking as planned.

why_it_matters: Sewer design bids, Fitchburg treatment invoices and any federal relief money feed into sewer rates and future capital projects that residents on those streets may be asked to fund.
Unpaid sewer invoices from last fiscal year are to be placed on tax bills, which touches property owners who are behind on sewer charges.
watch_next: Next meeting November 30 at 6 p.m. at town hall, then December 9 on Zoom.
The informal design proposals, to be shared with all commissioners, and the pending fourth price.
